answer_3.quote: We use two different automated classifiers: • The HarmBench classifier, a fine-tuned Llama 2 13B model providing a binary classification of harmfulness. It is the standard classifier used in the HarmBench benchmark. • The StrongREJECT classifier , which is a fine-tuned Gemma 2B model. This classifier outputs a score estimate of the harmfulness of a response between 0 and 1...
